name: Double Chocolate Flavoured Ice Cream
ingredients_raw: Ice Cream (60%): (Milk Solids, Sugar, Water, Cocoa Solids (4.5%), Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471 & 477), Stabilizers (410 & 412), Color (150d), Emulsifier (322) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances). Wafer Cone (13%): (Water, Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sugar, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm Kernel Oil), Color (150d) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances). Pencil Filling (6.5%): Choco Sauce (Sugar, Water, Liquid Glucose, Cocoa Solids, Fractionated Fat (Sal, Palm & Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin)), Cocoa Butter, Milk Solids, Vanilla Powder, Emulsifier (322) & Thickener (440)). Spraying & Toppings (20.5%): Cocoa Flavored Confectionery (Edible Vegetable Oils (Coconut Oil & Palm Kernel Oil), Sugar, Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier (322) & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavoring Substances) & Compound Chip (Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin) & Nature-Identical Flavoring Substances).
